description: Set up Jest infrastructure and write supertest integration tests for all four critical route groups (auth, trips, payments, tracking) with DB pool mocks and axios mocks for ORS. Also fix moduleNameMapper so the existing middleware tests compile cleanly.
steps: Install supertest and @types/supertest as devDependencies in services/api-gateway/package.json.

Create services/api-gateway/jest.config.js: preset ts-jest, testEnvironment node, roots ['<rootDir>/src', '<rootDir>/tests'], testPathIgnorePatterns ['dist'], setupFiles ['<rootDir>/src/__tests__/setup.ts'], moduleNameMapper to resolve @dalasmart/shared-types to packages/shared-types/src/index.ts (use <rootDir>/../../packages/shared-types/src/index.ts), transform ts-jest with isolatedModules:true.

Create services/api-gateway/src/__tests__/setup.ts: sets process.env.JWT_SECRET='test-secret', NODE_ENV='test', DATABASE_URL='postgresql://localhost/dalasmart_test' (won't actually connect because pool is mocked).

Create services/api-gateway/src/__tests__/helpers/jwt.ts: exports signTestToken({userId, userType}) using jsonwebtoken.sign with secret 'test-secret', expiresIn '1h'. Exports TEST_USER_ID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', TEST_DRIVER_ID='00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'.

Create services/api-gateway/src/__tests__/routes/auth.test.ts. Mock '../../../database/connection' returning pool with jest.fn() query. Import app from '../../../index'. Tests: POST /api/v1/auth/register — 201 success; 400 missing fields; 400 duplicate phone. POST /api/v1/auth/login — 200 valid; 401 wrong password; 403 inactive. GET /api/v1/auth/me — 200 with token; 401 without. PATCH /api/v1/auth/me — 200 name update; 400 no fields. POST /api/v1/auth/change-password — 200 success; 401 wrong current password.

Create services/api-gateway/src/__tests__/routes/trips.test.ts. Mock '../../../database/connection'. Tests: POST /api/v1/trips — 201; 400 missing coords; 401 no auth. GET /api/v1/trips/:id — 200; 404; 401. GET /api/v1/trips — 200 list. PATCH /api/v1/trips/:id/status — 200 valid; 400 invalid status; 403 not owner; 404. PATCH /api/v1/trips/:id/assign-driver — 200; 400 already assigned; 400 not pending; 404. PATCH /api/v1/trips/:id/complete — 200 driver; 403 passenger. PATCH /api/v1/trips/:id/cancel — 200; 400 already completed. POST /api/v1/trips/:id/rate — 200; 400 out of range; 400 not completed; 403 not participant. GET /api/v1/trips/available/nearby — 200; 400 missing coords.

Create services/api-gateway/src/__tests__/routes/payments.test.ts. Mock '../../../database' (default export: getClient returns mock client with query, release). Tests: GET /api/v1/payments/info — 200; 401. POST /api/v1/payments/pay cash — 200 pending_confirmation. POST /api/v1/payments/pay wallet sufficient — 200 completed. POST /api/v1/payments/pay wallet insufficient — 400. POST /api/v1/payments/pay mpesa valid Vodacom number (255744xxxxxx) — 200 pending+poll_url. POST /api/v1/payments/pay mpesa with Airtel number — 400 mismatch. POST /api/v1/payments/pay invalid context_id (not UUID) — 400. POST /api/v1/payments/pay amount<100 — 400. GET /api/v1/payments/status/:ref — 200; 404. GET /api/v1/payments/receipt/:ref — 200; 404.

Create services/api-gateway/src/__tests__/routes/tracking.test.ts. Mock '../../../database/connection'. Mock 'axios'. Tests: POST /api/v1/tracking/driver/update — 200; 400; 401. POST /api/v1/tracking/driver/location — 200. GET /api/v1/tracking/driver/:id — 200 from memory after update. GET /api/v1/tracking/nearby — 200; 400. POST /api/v1/tracking/driver/offline — 200. POST /api/v1/tracking/calculate-route — 200 is_estimate:true (no ORS key); 400 missing coords; validates response shape. GET /api/v1/tracking/route?trip_id=X — 200 after calculate; 404. GET /api/v1/tracking/trip/:id — 200 mock fallback. GET /api/v1/tracking/nearby-drivers — 200; 400. GET /api/v1/tracking/traffic — 200; 400.

Run npm test from services/api-gateway. Fix any TypeScript or import errors. Check that existing middleware tests (auth.test.ts, rbac.test.ts, validation.test.ts) still pass or patch them minimally if the moduleNameMapper resolves @dalasmart/shared-types to a stub that satisfies their imports.
acceptance_criteria: Running `cd services/api-gateway && npm test` exits 0 with all suites green.
At minimum 40 test cases pass across the four route test files.
The existing middleware test files (auth.test.ts, rbac.test.ts, validation.test.ts) either pass or are explicitly skipped with a comment explaining the dependency gap, not deleted.
No real database connections or HTTP calls are made during the test run.
.env.example is NOT required for this FEAT (belongs to FEAT-002).
